description.value: A working floor around a mineral chimney where sulphide crusts were cut for tools and for exchange for as long as the vent ran. The vent failed in 2276 and the site was abandoned within a year. Cut faces, discarded blanks and a stacked pile of unfinished crust remain exactly where they were left.

notes.value: The survey watched the vent die across three visits and recorded the abandonment in full. Nobody involved has been willing to describe the resulting file as a good outcome, though it is the best-documented abandonment in the register.
